comments.body:
Another instance, 2026-11-09 on 0.24 on the devenv, where the agent was found late for a different reason. A Codex helper started with `muster pane new --helper --run '<codex launcher>'` in a directory Codex had not seen opened on its folder-trust dialog. A brief posted with `muster msg post --to <helper> --file` answered "rung once an agent is found". Muster reported the helper blocked at a dialog after 3 minutes. After the dialog was answered with `muster pane send --key Enter`, Codex sat idle at its prompt, and `muster window --json` showed the pane `state: done, rang: false`. The brief was never delivered and nothing said so; it went in with `pane send --file`.

So the ring wants to fire whenever an agent is first found in the pane, after a dialog as well as after a restart. Possibly also: mark a post as not delivered when its recipient never became reachable, so the sender sees it.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-06. A brief was posted while Codex sat at its upgrade prompt; accepting the upgrade made Codex exit, and it was restarted in the same pane with `pane send`. Muster showed it `done` at an empty prompt but never rang post #4, whose own answer had said "rung once an agent is found". A later notice said "no agent is in its pane any more". A second post rang at once.

Ring for any unread post to a pane when an agent is detected there, or say on the post that a restart will not ring it.
title: A post to a pane whose agent died does not ring the agent restarted there
